title: 订单数
question: 上个月深圳的订单量
sql:
SELECT
  COUNT(DISTINCT o.order_id) AS order_count
FROM orders AS o
JOIN stores AS s
  ON o.store_id = s.store_id
WHERE
  o.status IN ('paid', 'refunded')
  AND o.order_date BETWEEN '2026-09-01' AND '2026-09-30'
  AND s.city = '深圳'
LIMIT 1000

FROM (

    channel,

    order_id,
    pay_amount,
    refund_amount,
    region_id,
    status,
    store_id

    region_id IN ('south')

JOIN (
